name: Ananya Dasgupta
text: The Nethili shutki tastes just like what my grandmother used to make. Beautifully cleaned and packed!

name: Rahul Menon
text: Dried prawns were incredibly fresh and aromatic. Packaging was leak-proof and premium.

name: Suchitra Nair
text: Loved the boneless shutki — so convenient for a quick weekday curry. Will reorder.

name: Imran Shaikh
text: Fast pan-India delivery and the quality is genuinely premium. The combo box is great value.

name: Priya Balan
text: Finally a brand that gets coastal flavour right. The king fish shutki is outstanding.

name: Debjani Roy
text: Authentic taste, hygienic packing and lovely branding. Highly recommend TheShutki.
